name: Mortis Rituals — 3 Advanced — Walk Through the Shroud

system.description: You can step beyond the world of mortals to the place where souls still tied to the Earth dwell. The ghosts you encounter may provide information or eldritch service, but many do not view Cainites kindly and may attempt to harm you. You must surround yourself with grave dust and perform chanting incantations from dusk to midnight, then perform a Mental Challenge. Success frees your soul similarly to Anima Walk, sending it across the shroud into the dismal world of lost souls. While there, you have access to Mental and Social Disciplines and can be affected by ghostly inhabitants as if one of their own; as with Anima Walk, you are unaware of your corporeal body. Your stay lasts until dawn or until you decide to return, and you can bring back nothing but your memories.
